name: Mclaren MP4/4 F1 car (1988)
author: Kenkento3D
description:
Mid-poly mp4/4 f1 car driven by Ayrton Senna.
The McLaren MP4/4 was a dominant f1 car driven by Alain Prost and Aytron Senna.
The bodywork texture has 4k textures, the rest of the model have 2k textures.  
Engine and cockpit (inside) are not modelled completely                                                                                                                                                                                 50831 Vertices          100756 Edges          50000 exact faces
